t: A four-wheel Arduino robot car kit with a Wi-Fi camera.
steps: Buy the kit from the ELEGOO store or a shop such as Micro Center.
Download the V4.0 lesson package from the ELEGOO tutorial page.
Build the car with the assembly guide in the package.
Install the free Arduino IDE and the CH340 USB driver on your computer.
Add the zip libraries from the package to the Arduino IDE.
Check which motor driver and gyro your kit has. Open the matching main sketch.
Upload the sketch and try the obstacle avoidance mode first.
Install the ELEGOO Robot app on your phone and drive with the camera.
meta: Open Board. From $75.99. A few stores.
